title: One standards record schema and store; the global standards file renders from the whole pack
body:
Why: Fable plan 1114e (.krn/runs/overnight/fable-plan-1114e.md) slice 5: five stores, three schemas (standards/records.json Standard, .agents/conventions.json BrainRecord, ~/.claude/krn-standards.md from 4 universal conventions only, proposals, memory dir).
Outcome: one schema {id,type standard|convention|pitfall|recipe,text,why,audience,tier,applies{stacks,needs,paths,terms},enforcement,provenance{origin,evidence[],proposals[]},status trial|accepted|retired,recorded_at,valid_from,valid_to,supersedes} in standards/records.json + per-repo overlay .agents/records.json; conventions migrated; packet and briefStandards read it; global file renders top universal records within 2048 B.
Proof: krn standards install --global --check; more than 4 records within 2048 B; zod schema test; FR-40 packet bytes unchanged for the KRN arm or re-measured.
